name: Curtains
description: The first clip parts in the middle like stage curtains, gathering into shaded folds as it is pulled to the sides. Drive `progress` from 0 to 1.

inputs.name: second
inputs.description: Incoming clip (same size as the first)

params.name: folds
params.description: Number of folds in each curtain

params.name: shading
params.description: Depth of the shading on the folds

params.name: bunch
params.description: Width of each gathered curtain, as a part of the frame width

params.name: sway
params.description: How much the bottom of the curtains lags behind the top
